bear_case: The three confirmed gates (BTC Gate 1, Gate 2, NVDA OTC above $195) represent the most constructive framework setup in this 10-session period — but four binary determinations remain live on July 6 that could each independently undermine the portfolio activation sequence: (1) IBIT Gate 3 PENDING — corrected data shows IBIT in a 10-day outflow streak as of July 2 (-$40.43M). Total spot ETF +$221.7M on July 3 was FBTC/ARKB-led, NOT IBIT. If IBIT remains in outflow on July 6, Gate 3 fails and BTC re-entry is blocked — this is the most likely scenario for under-activation. (2) NVDA Stop Day 2 OTC vs Close divergence — OTC at $197.16 (above $195) is encouraging but OTC prints are thin and non-binding. Services PMI at 9:45 AM ET July 6 disappointing + general post-holiday gap risk could push NVDA below $195 at the official US close (Stop Day 2 = mandatory full exit July 7 open). (3) SPCX Day 9 distribution surge — sellers delayed from July 3–5 may release pent-up orders concentrated in July 6 morning, creating above-40M volume that pushes clearance to July 14+ and narrows the IG floor buffer below $10. (4) SK Hynix July 6 KST gap — 72+ hours of holiday gap creates potential for negative news (Apple CXMT contract confirmation, new YMTC news) surfacing Sunday UTC that would open KST below ₩2,540,000 (new Stop Day 1 triggered immediately). The most dangerous 'false confirmation' scenario: BTC Gate 2 confirmed + NVDA OTC above $195 + VIX 15.78 creates a deceptively bullish surface read on July 5 morning, but IBIT Gate 3 failing at July 6 open (the single remaining gate) means no re-entry is activated — portfolio sits at half-size NVDA + no BTC exposure on a day the SPX may open up 0.5–1.0% on post-holiday relief.
